policy: Only reviewed original employee payment schedules enter the proposed collection.
Executive-only, board, supplier, contractor and aggregate payroll reports remain separate scopes.
No source values altered to force totals, no explanation inferred for unresolved residuals, no blank converted tozero.
Document periods take precedence over upload or compiler labels.

Nine proved duplicate compiled InBC rows carry an explicit source- and cohort-hash-pinned 2023/24-to-2022/23 replacement decision. Other original compiled rows remain retained. No requests, FOI submissions or external messages sent.
